Teamchef Ralf Rangnick has reacted to the injury of Christoph Baumgartner, who was nominated for the World Cup by Schalke's Dejan Ljubicic. Ljubicic, a defensive midfielder, was expected at the Austrian National Team's team quarters in California, as reported by the Austrian Football Association. Ljubicic has played nine international matches and scored one goal for Austria. Since his transfer from Zagreb to Gelsenkirchen in January, he has played all 15 Bundesliga matches and scored four goals. Ljubicic replaces injured Christoph Baumgartner, who was injured during warm-up for the Tunisia test match on June 1. Ljubicic played his ninth and last international match in September 2023, a 1:1 home draw against the Republic of Moldova. In Santa Barbara, Ljubicic will also meet the injured Baumgartner. The RB Leipzig player will continue his rehabilitation in the Austrian National Team camp, as reported by RB. The Austrian Football Association and RB Leipzig have agreed to Ljubicic's wish to complete his rehabilitation in the Austrian National Team environment and support his teammates during the World Cup.

Christoph Baumgartner will join the Austrian national team later on Wednesday at the World although he misses the tournament for injury reasons.

Baumgartner's German club RB Leipzig said that he will continue his rehabilitation from a thigh muscle injury which required surgery at the team's camp in Santa Barbara, California.

Midfielder Baumgartner sustained the injury in his right leg in the warm-up for a recent World Cup tune-up match against Tunisia, ruling him out of the June 11-July 19 tournament in the US, Mexico and Canada.

Leipzig said that Baumgartner still wanted to be with the national and granted his request to continue his recovery there. He will be looked after by Austrian team doctors in close cooperation with Leipzig's medical department.

Austria start the World Cup on Tuesday against debutants Jordan and also play defending champions Argentina and Algeria in the group stage.

# World Cup 2026: Austria's David Alaba passed fit but Christoph Baumgartner ruled out of tournament - BBC Sport

Published: 2026-06-02T12:12:44Z
Source: BBC (bbc.com)
Language: en

## Story

World Cup 2026: Austria's David Alaba passed fit but Christoph Baumgartner ruled out of tournament - BBC Sport

Getty Images

Christoph Baumgartner has scored 19 goals in 58 caps for Austria

Ben Ramsdale

BBC Sport journalist

4 minutes ago

Austria captain David Alaba has been given the all clear to travel for the World Cup after picking up a muscle injury on Monday but midfielder Christoph Baumgartner has been ruled out of the tournament.

Former Bayern Munich and Real Madrid defender Alaba was substituted at half-time of Austria's 1-0 friendly win against Tunisia but has been passed fit to travel to America with the rest of the squad.

It is not such positive news for RB Leipzig midfielder Baumgartner, however.

The 26-year-old suffered a thigh muscle injury during Monday's pre-match warm-up and has been ruled out of the World Cup, the country's football association confirmed on Tuesday.

Baumgartner is one of Austria's more important players and enjoyed a fantastic season in Germany, scoring 17 goals and providing nine assists in all competitions for the Bundesliga club.

"This is of course very bitter news for Christoph and for us as a team," coach Ralf Rangnick said in a statement.

"He is an important player and a central personality within our team. Now our full support is for his recovery."

Austria's World Cup campaign begins against Jordan on 16 June before taking on reigning world champions Argentina on 22 June and rounding off against Algeria on 28 June.

# World Cup 2026: Christoph Baumgartner travels to the Austria team despite injury

#### Bytaketonews

## Rehabilitation program with the national team Despite injury: Bundesliga star travels to the World Cup quarters

June 10, 2026 – 10:07 amReading time: 1 min.

Christoph Baumgartner: The Austrian is a top performer in Leipzig. (Source: IMAGO/Laci Perenyi/imago)

Leipzig’s Christoph Baumgartner misses the World Cup due to an injury – but is still traveling to the USA. A special situation awaits him there in the Austrian team camp.

Despite a muscle injury in his right thigh, Austrian national player Christoph Baumgartner is traveling to the USA for the World Cup. The attacking midfielder from RB Leipzig will complete his rehab at the Austrian national team’s team camp in Santa Barbara – at his own request in order to support his teammates on site.

Both the Austrian Football Association (ÖFB) and RB Leipzig have granted the 26-year-old’s wish. As RB announced, Baumgartner will work on his comeback in Santa Barbara under medical support from the ÖFB and in close coordination with his club.

Baumgartner sustained the injury while warming up before the international friendly against Tunisia. Austria won the game 1-0. He then underwent surgery in Turku, Finland.

At the World Cup, Austria will face defending champions Argentina, Algeria and Jordan in the group stage. The selection coach is the German Ralf Rangnick.
